summary: Reproduction confirmed ZeroDivisionError in calculate_metrics caused by unguarded empty input list.

evidence.message: ZeroDivisionError: division by zero encountered during average calculation
Denominator 'count' is derived from len(values) without a preceding non-empty check.

reproduction.stderr:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "test/fixtures/sample-python/main.py", line 32, in <module>
    main()
  File "test/fixtures/sample-python/main.py", line 27, in main
    result = calculate_metrics(dataset)
  File "test/fixtures/sample-python/main.py", line 15, in calculate_metrics
    average = total / count
ZeroDivisionError: division by zero

diagnoses.title: ZeroDivisionError due to unguarded empty collection in calculate_metrics
diagnoses.description: calculate_metrics divides total by count without checking whether count (len(values)) is greater than zero.
diagnoses.rootCause: Direct division operation total / count on line 15 without a guard condition when values is empty (count == 0).
alternatives: Caller should validate non-empty collection prior to invoking calculate_metrics
calculate_metrics should return None or 0.0 when values is empty

limitations: Dynamic analysis executed without unit test runner
External library dependencies were not inspected
